summary: Fixed the ledger package so it follows docs/conventions.md: half-away-from-zero rounding, negative amount formatting, header-over-dialect precedence, fiscal quarter boundaries, rate file ranges and lookback-only rate choice, reversals booked and valued on the original's date (also for tax and returns), sums of per-entry rounded values in reports, journal and revaluation, and several smaller fixes. All 755 unit tests pass and tools/audit.py reports 0 failed checks.
